annotation.authors_or_issuer: Huang, W.; Sun, K.; Weng, Z.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a general education course 'The Robot World' moving from technical cognition to value shaping.
Integrates robotics fundamentals, ethics, law, social impact and cutting-edge applications.
Uses blended online-offline, experiential and project-based teaching.
Advocates 'Curriculum Ideology and Politics' to deepen professional ideals and ethics education.
Aligned with China's Double First-Class Initiative and Five-in-One educational philosophy.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article describing development of a university general education course, 'The Robot World', in China. It combines robotics fundamentals with ethics, law and social impact through blended and experiential teaching, and uses 'Curriculum Ideology and Politics' to cultivate ethical values and robotics literacy among students from diverse majors.
annotation.title_clean: Course Development for "The Robot World": Cultivating Ethical Values within Technical Education
annotation.title_en: Course Development for "The Robot World": Cultivating Ethical Values within Technical Education
